notes.title: New Levels, Special Traps, New Weapons & Exciting Animations in Bagel!
notes.content:
Dear Bagel Players,

We are thrilled to announce an exciting update! We've added a new level to our game: School Court. We hope you'll enjoy the Basketball Court level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985418/a95e8fae83354c158b7292fbe92de5eb8399d435.png

Every level in our game is now filled with its own special traps. In the Classroom level, watch out for Bear Traps; in the Basketball Court level, get ready to dodge basketball-themed traps!

Be cautious when encountering these traps. They can cause serious damage or provide strategic advantages, such as immobilizing enemies or dealing damage. We aim for each level to have its unique dynamics and continue to enhance our updates.

With these customized traps, we've made the game experience even more thrilling. We can't wait for you to tackle these new challenges!

Don't forget to share your thoughts and feedback on the update. Remember, the game's new maps and traps are shaped by your ideas. Wishing you success in this adventure filled with new traps!

New Weapons:

 Katana
 Axe
 Hot Dog
 Aubergiene


New Special Traps:

 Basketball Ball
 Bear Trap


New Level:

 School Court


New Animations:

 Taunt
 Flat Fall
 Knockdown
 Slip and Fall


Best regards,
Bahadır NURAL

notes.title: Steam Achievements Now on Bagel!
notes.content:
Achievements Now on Bagel!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985418/08785f75cd988b580c267c17643c1a8304f30977.jpg
These are now 14 new achievements in Bagel.

 VILLIAN KILLER: Let the villians fear me!
 TRAP MASTER: You trapped enemies 20 times.
 HUNGER:  You ate more than 10 meals in one go.
 WEAPON MASTER: Change weapons 10 times in one game.
 MEDIC: Recover 3000 health in total.
 VANDAL: Deal 3000 total damage.
 I AM PUNK: Play with Punk 50 Times.
 I AM HACKER: Play with Hacker 50 Times.
 I AM TRAINER: Play with Trainer 50 Times.
 I AM INFLUENCER: Play with Influencer 50 Times.
 I AM RICH: Play with Rich 50 Times.
 LAST BOSS: Win 15 games as a Villain.
 TANK: Finish with over 80% health as a punk.
 SURVIVOR: Finish the game with very low health.

Enjoy your successes. Updates on new achievements and achievement icons will continue to arrive. We do our best to offer top quality.
